paper_title: UPconversion Loop Oscillator Axion Detection experiment: A precision frequency interferometric axion dark matter search with a Cylindrical Microwave Cavity
notes: AxionPhoton haloscope (UPLOAD-CMC), corrected values from the erratum/corrected version (v5, June 2021), which supersede the original 2019 numbers after a sign-error fix. Headline MEASURED limit is the UPCONVERSION result (paper title + conclusion): 95% CL exclusion of g_agamma over the axion mass range 7.44-19.38 neV, traced from the corrected exclusion plot (Fig. 3 of the corrected Letter / Fig. 2 of the erratum, file ExclusionPlotUpdatedFull5.pdf, the zoomed 'neV' sub-panel). The lower boundary of the excluded (dark) region rises roughly monotonically from the quoted minimum ~3e-3 1/GeV at the low-mass end to ~8e-3 1/GeV at 19.38 neV, with narrow downward sensitivity spikes; abstract/conclusion quote the minimum as 'above 3x10^-3 1/GeV'. Traced curve is a smooth envelope of that boundary (factor <~2 across the band). Density: paper assumes rho_DM = 8e-22 kg/m^3 = 0.45 GeV/cm^3 (not rescaled per task). The paper also reports a secondary DOWNCONVERSION measured region at g_agamma ~1.0-1.3e-2 1/GeV (flat ~10^-2) over 74.4-74.5 ueV (7.44e-5-7.45e-5 eV); this is omitted here as it is not the paper's main/title result. Dashed curves (UPLOAD-CMC-II/III RT/Cryo) are projections and are excluded. g_agamma is already in the canonical L = -(g/4) a F Ftilde convention; no conversion needed.
